training_focus: Distinguish FITS header provenance, MSA geometry consistency, published line arithmetic, and actually independently re-extracted spectral maps

physics_observations.finding: 16 long exposure pairs have 32 separately inspected MAST FITS primary headers. 16 exposure MSAMETIDs independently match SHUTTER_INFO from two full archived MSA tables, each containing the metadata for eight dithers. The MSA table's signed int16 ids must be normalized modulo 65536 before comparison.
physics_observations.limitation: A verified FITS association does not localize the 16004-A signal on the detector or sky.

physics_observations.finding: The discovery paper tests [O III] 4960 near 15864 A, but 16004*(4960.295/5008.239)=15850.79 A. Difference 13.21 A versus observed FWHM 13.2 A. Paper's quoted 3-sigma local flux limit at 15864 A cannot be promoted to a same-wavelength negative at 15850.79 A.
The published A/B/C/D fluxes fit a constant-line model with chi-squared=2.3835 (3 dof), survival probability=0.4967. This is no proof of permanence and does not rule out a slow supernova or TDE.

JADES NW galaxy is 0.6352 arcsec at bearing 328.23 degrees from orphan; S galaxy is 1.0379 arcsec at 174.54 degrees. If both cloud and galaxies share Pa-beta z~0.249, projected separations are 2.55 and 4.17 kpc, requiring at least ~8.3 and ~13.6 thousand years of one-way light travel between illuminating source and cloud.

scenario_comparison.test: Pa-gamma around 1.365 micrometers, dust attenuation, same-z faint disk host, 2023 October F150W epoch
Resolved host nucleus, H-alpha/other-line measurements, light curve and line-width evolution
3x3 arcsecond NIRSpec IFU covers orphan and three neighboring galaxies; require shared spectroscopic z, offsets and spatial line morphology
Re-extract the right 15850.79-A window independently, not the erroneous 15864-A paper check

training_antipatterns.claim: We processed all 16 spectra and found the line
training_antipatterns.label: REJECT_FALSE_REEXTRACTION
training_antipatterns.reason: Only 32 RATE headers and 16 MSA IDs verified, while full stage-2 WCS line map remains absent.

training_antipatterns.claim: Archive does not contain calibrated products therefore there is no real emission
training_antipatterns.label: REJECT_ARCHIVE_COMPLETENESS_FALLACY
training_antipatterns.reason: Only two representative MAST product lists were queried and the paper performed custom calibrated extraction.

training_antipatterns.claim: Source paper says the [O III] 4960 line at 15864 A is missing, so oxygen is excluded
training_antipatterns.label: REJECT_WRONG_WAVELENGTH_NEGATIVE
training_antipatterns.reason: Vacuum rest-line ratio predicts 15850.79 A; expected flux ~0.83e-18 is also below the quoted 3-sigma depth.

training_antipatterns.claim: The NIRSpec grating draws a 4-kpc luminous streak toward the NW galaxy
training_antipatterns.label: REJECT_DETECTOR_BEAM_MISREAD
training_antipatterns.reason: Angular galaxy separation is conditional projected sky geometry, not a spatially mapped propagation path.

training_antipatterns.claim: A flat four-stack light curve rules out a transient
training_antipatterns.label: REJECT_WEAK_STATISTICAL_DISCRIMINATION
training_antipatterns.reason: p~0.50 under constant flux means no detected variability over 88 days; a months-long transient remains possible.
